The driver cancelled this trip and picked "rider_no_show" as the reason, with a $5.00 fee on record [F3], so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1 / NS-2. A single failed NS-1 condition voids the fee in full [NS-2].

The driver's written statement that he pressed "I'm Here", called and waited more than 5 minutes "at the pickup" [F14] conflicts with the GPS and timeline records; system records override statements, so the statement cannot support the charge [F1][F2][F5][NS-1].
